method: We kept zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers certified for rooms of 500 sq ft or more and took those with the lowest five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Running cost carries most of the weight, rated room size the rest. Every model tied with the last one on the selection criterion is listed, so the cut never picks among equals.
name: Air purifiers for large rooms that cost the least to run, ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: 5-year electricity cost
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields

ties.rule: equal scores share a rank; within it products are listed alphabetically (no measured difference)
